# Documentation Instructions

Use the official name: Specification-Driven Coding.

Preserve the official pipeline:

Raw request -> Intake -> Specification -> Project Profile Selection -> Vertical Blueprint -> Plan -> Tasks -> Implementation -> Evaluation Scorecard -> Release/Iteration

Do not add AI provenance, private prompt history, derivative framing, or wrong methodology names.

Keep public docs clear: what it is, why it exists, how to use it, and how to validate it.

Do not turn concise docs into manifesto duplicates.
